sens_en: to correct, to straighten, to feign
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi écrit 矯 et le glose « presse pour redresser les flèches » : 矢, la flèche, et 喬 pour le son. 乔 se lit qiáo : il ne donne plus le son de jiǎo. Redresser le bois de la flèche : corriger, 矫正.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi writes 矯 and glosses it “a press for straightening arrows”: 矢, the arrow, and 喬 for the sound. 乔 is read qiáo: it no longer gives the sound of jiǎo. Straightening an arrow shaft: to correct, 矫正.

phrase.fr: Il se fait redresser les dents.
phrase.en: He is having his teeth straightened.
